# PolyLens — Free Polymarket Audit & 2026 FIFO Koinly Tax CSV

> Live App: https://polylens-zeta.vercel.app
> 2026 FIFO Tax CSV Export: https://polylens-zeta.vercel.app/tax-export
> MCP Server (Free): npx -y polylens-mcp
> Telegram Bot (Free): https://t.me/polylens_alerts_bot
> Treasury (Base & Polygon USDC): 0xcC52589F7F1E8b95101e8454CeAA3742533f7FF6

## Free Endpoints
- `GET /api/wallet?address=0x...` — Free Polymarket lifetime PnL, rank, win rate, entry fees burned, redeemable balance & Trader Card.
- `GET /api/whale-tape?minUsd=5000&sort=recent` — Free top-15 live Polymarket trades above `minUsd`.
- `GET /api/tax-preview?address=0x...&year=2026` — Free `/v2/activity` FIFO taxable event count & net direction scan.

## Paid Tax Export (7.00 USDC, Replay-Protected)
Send 7 USDC on Base (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) or Polygon (`0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359` / `0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174`) to `0xcC52589F7F1E8b95101e8454CeAA3742533f7FF6`, then submit via `/tax-export` or `GET /api/tax-export?address=0x...&year=2026&tx=0x...` to unlock full Koinly CSV (`realized gain` spec with negative losses) and detailed accountant ledger.
